email_subject: Application - Frontend PHP Developer at Eummena
email_body:
Dear Eummena team,

I'm applying for the Frontend PHP Developer role. Your focus on open EdTech and Moodle aligns with my background in frontend development and web technologies.

At ViviDoctor, I developed front-end features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript. Since then, I've built and optimized websites on WordPress, working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP-based systems. I'm comfortable with Git for version control and have experience with responsive design and accessible markup. I also use AI tools and Python automation to streamline workflows.

I'm a fast learner, self-motivated, and thrive in distributed teams. I'm eager to contribute to Moodle's DevOps squad and grow my skills in a meaningful EdTech environment.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Eummena team,

I'm writing to apply for the Frontend PHP Developer position. Your mission to enable Quality Education for All through open EdTech resonates with me, and I'm excited about the opportunity to contribute to Moodle's DevOps squad.

My background combines frontend development with hands-on web experience. At ViviDoctor, I developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript. Since then, I've built and maintained websites on WordPress, working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP-based systems. I've implemented responsive designs, accessible markup, and structured data, and I'm comfortable using Git for version control. I also use AI tools and Python automation to streamline repetitive tasks, which fits well with an Agile DevOps mindset.

I'm a fast learner who enjoys working in distributed teams. I communicate clearly in English and am comfortable collaborating with clients and colleagues to analyse features and find optimal solutions. While I haven't worked with Moodle specifically, I'm eager to learn and contribute to your platforms. My experience with frontend frameworks and libraries, combined with my self-motivated approach, positions me to quickly adapt to your stack.

I'm drawn to Eummena's human-first culture and the chance to make a global educational impact. I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills can support your team.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
